class.name: Streamline
class.description: Global streamline interface, facilitates advanced graphics features.

method.name: get_frame_generation_status
method.description: Returns a consistent snapshot of ordinary 2X Frame Generation eligibility and application SDK options. [code]available[/code] reports runtime support, [code]eligible[/code] requires exactly one rendered 3D view requesting Frame Generation directly in a window, and [code]reason[/code] explains fallback ([code]unavailable[/code], [code]editor[/code], [code]no_3d_view[/code], [code]no_request[/code], [code]multiple_3d_views[/code], or [code]offscreen_viewport[/code]). [code]rendered_3d_views[/code] and [code]requested_3d_views[/code] count visible 3D views, including multiview layers. 2D HUD viewports do not count. [code]sdk_enabled[/code] reflects successfully submitted enable/disable options, not actual generated frames or presentation quality. [code]supported_generated_frames[/code] is at most one for this integration (ordinary 2X); it does not advertise MFG or Dynamic MFG. The snapshot is updated on the render thread and can lag a property change until the next draw. SubViewport and multiple-3D-view arrangements retain their requested properties and render normally without Frame Generation.

The default DLSS preset to use. Valid values: ?,Recommended,F,G,H,I,J,K,L,M,N,O. [code]Recommended[/code] requests K for DLAA/Quality/Balanced, M for Performance, and L for Ultra Performance. M and L request DLSS 4.5 Super Resolution. Explicit letters apply to every Super Resolution mode. Driver overrides may change the active model.
